# Source: "Costume Parisien" Fashion Plates from Journal des Dames et Des Modes and Costume Parisien (The Journal of Ladies and Fashion)

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** "Costume Parisien" Fashion Plates from Journal des Dames et Des Modes and Costume Parisien (The Journal of Ladies and Fashion)
- **Artist / culture:** Paris, France
- **Date:** 1804 and 1806
- **Style:** 19th century
- **Classification:** fashion plate
- **Department:** Textiles
- **AIC artwork ID:** 149634
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/149634
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/89ff4e5b-1ed3-a4e5-ae0d-f48a33fb15fd/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Fashion Plate

## Extracted source palette

`#F8E8C8, #E8C8A8, #C8B898, #B89888, #988878, #787858, #685848, #E8A878`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#FCF5E8`
- `surface`: `#FEFCF7`
- `on_surface`: `#0F0F11`
- `primary`: `#E8A878`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#685848`
- `surface_variant`: `#E0D9CE`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#0F0F11`
- `outline`: `#BAB5AC`
- `error`: `#E8A878`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `rounded` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `16dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `17.66:1`, surface `18.67:1`
- Variant contrast: `13.66:1`
- Control contrast: `9.59:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
